title: Finite simultaneous representatives of raw sections
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ be a precoverage on $F(j)$, let $V$ be a cocone with vertex $C$, and let $Q$ be a precoverage on $C$. Assume every transition $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and that the object and arrow cocones of $V$ are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Fix $i\in J$ and a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. For $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ put $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$ and $V_t=V_{t.right}$. Give sheaf maps $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^sA_{t'}$ for $b:t\to t'$, whose composites with the inverse-image unit of $G$ are the unit at $t'$, componentwise as objects of the arrow category of sets. Let $B:\mathrm{Under}(i)\to\mathrm{PSh}(C)$ and $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^pB_t$ exhibit $B_t$ as the left Kan extension along $V_t^{op}$. Assume $\beta_t(X) B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of the arrow category of sets. Write $H=\mathrm{colim}\,B$ and $\rho_t(X)(s)=\iota_t(V_tX)(\beta_t(X)(s))$. For any $j\in J$, finite set $I$, objects $Y_p\in F(j)$, and sections $x_p\in H(V_jY_p)$, there are $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $a:j\to t.right$, equalities $e_U:V_t(F(a)U)=V_jU$ for every $U\in F(j)$, and sections $s_p\in A_t(F(a)Y_p)$ with $\rho_t(F(a)Y_p)(s_p)=H(e_{Y_p})(x_p)$. No covering family or compatibility of the $x_p$ is assumed.

proof.text: Evaluate the outer presheaf colimit and apply Types.jointly_surjective_of_isColimit. Apply Functor.isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionOfIsLeftKanExtension and joint surjectivity again to present the element by one section and one restriction arrow. The private kan_element implements this pointwise Kan presentation.

Reuse restriction_at_stage from ColimitSiteAbelianFiniteObjectSectionLift via a proof-only import all. This proved helper represents the restriction arrow using the object and arrow set-colimits while retaining the prescribed source stage. Its conclusion supplies the refinement, transition from the section stage, and lifted arrow with the required image.

The private one_raw_section composes beta with the outer coprojections to form delta. The beta-map hypothesis and colimit.w give its transition equation as an equality of Arrow objects. Naturality along the lifted restriction arrow then produces a representative at a refinement of the prescribed source stage. Naturality along equality arrows shows that every further refinement preserves the representative after transport. No composition law for theta, nor h-theta, is needed. Reuse arrow_comp_congr from ColimitSiteAbelianStageImageRefinement via a proof-only import all to compose the two equalities of Arrow objects.

Choose a common successor k of i and j, and transport all evaluation objects from j to k. Apply one_raw_section separately to the finite family. IsFiltered.sup_objs_exists in Under t0 supplies a common later refinement for all representatives, including when the family is empty. Compose the arrow from j to k with its refinement arrow. The cocone equation supplies object equalities for every U. The private untransport_raw and functoriality identify the final beta/coprojection values with the required restriction of x.
